title: Invertibility of realized compact-support coefficient exchange
statement: Let $K_0$ be a field in which the prime $\ell$ is invertible. Let $f:X\to Y$ be a separated finite-type $K_0$-morphism of finite-type schemes, and fix a compactification $c$ [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties, def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support]. Let $E,L$ be finite extensions of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ and $\iota:E\to L$ a $\mathbf Q_\ell$-algebra embedding. On the integral constructible category [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], the coefficientExchange of [def-weil-system-operation-exchange-realization] for the actual systemCompactScalar of the proper/open composite is invertible at every input $K$. This asserts invertibility of the middle exchange before conjugation by compactRealization, and makes no finite-unit normalization or rational assertion.

proof.text: Transport the given base-field unit to the residue field at each point of X and Y, through global sections and evaluation; use its canonical inverse as the local Invertible instance required by compactRealization. The normalized compactRealization projection equation identifies the evaluated operationReduction counit, composed with three isomorphisms, with sfCompactSupportFiniteReductionIso. Cancel the invertible factors on both sides to prove that every evaluation of this counit is invertible. Joint conservativity of the coefficient system evaluations therefore makes the whole counit invertible. This uses the fixed normalized compactification realization rather than a separate arbitrary comparison of Roos objects.

proof.text: Both c.Z and Y are Noetherian: their structure maps to Spec K0 are locally of finite type and quasi-compact (for c.Z compose the proper c.g with the structure map of Y). Apply finite-type-over-Noetherian and compactness. At each n, reductionEvaluation transports the input reduction constructibility to evaluation of its actual system N. The restricted integral scalar-extension functor preserves constructibility, and scalarReductionIso followed by reductionEvaluation identifies evaluation of S_X N with reduction of that scalar extension. Isomorphism closure transports bounded constructibility across these comparisons. Apply the finite evaluated mate lemma, then joint conservativity, to show systemCompactScalar.app N invertible.

proof.text: Unfold scalarSourceComparison only to its specified realization isomorphism and total limit of scalar extension applied to the reconstruction counit of step 1. Functors preserve isomorphisms, so it is invertible. Unfold coefficientExchange to its source comparison, total limit of the system mate of step 2, and the whiskered inverse scalarReductionIso. All three factors are invertible; infer invertibility of their composite. The existing target statement is unchanged.

theorem sfCompactSupportCoefficientExchange_isIso
    (E L : Type u) [Field E] [Field L]
    [Algebra (Padic l) E] [Algebra (Padic l) L]
    [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) L]
    (ι : E →ₐ[Padic l] L) (K : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E X) :
    IsIso ((FrobeniusExchange.coefficientExchange l E L ι
      (FrobeniusExchange.systemDerivedOpen l E c.i ⋙ FrobeniusExchange.systemDirect l E c.g)
      (FrobeniusExchange.systemDerivedOpen l L c.i ⋙ FrobeniusExchange.systemDirect l L c.g)
      (FrobeniusExchange.systemCompactScalar l E L ι c)).app K)
